meta_description: Steve Tovey Painter and Decorator in Bristol. Interior and exterior decorating, expert finish, free quotes. Call 07817 917893 today.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior work done right, on time, and at a fair price. Free quotes, no obligation.
services_subhead: From interior room refreshes to full exterior repaints, I handle every job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Room refreshes, feature walls, and full house redecorating. I prepare surfaces properly and use quality paint to ensure a finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Fascias, soffits, doors, and weatherboarding. Weather-resistant finishes protect your home and improve its kerb appeal for years to come.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Pattern matching, feature walls, and tricky corners handled with precision. Includes full wall preparation and old paper removal.

services.title: Woodwork & Varnishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and banisters stripped, sanded, and finished to a professional standard. Enhances the character of period and modern homes alike.

services.title: Textured Finishes
services.desc: Artex removal and replacement, Polished Plaster, and other bespoke finishes. Creates visual interest and hides minor wall imperfections naturally.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Shop fronts, offices, and rental properties. I work around your schedule and deliver a smart, professional finish on time.

about_pullquote: I do work I'd be happy to see in my own home.
about_para_1: I've been decorating homes and businesses across Bristol for over 20 years. Started as an apprentice, learned the trade properly, and built a reputation on showing up on time, doing the job right, and charging a fair price. Every project—whether it's a quick bedroom refresh or a full exterior repaint—gets the same attention to detail.
about_para_2: My customers come back because I listen to what they want, I'm honest about timescales, and I clean up properly when I'm done. I take pride in the finish, not just the invoice. If something doesn't meet my standard, I'll put it right.

reviews.text: Steve came highly recommended and he lived up to it. Did our lounge and hallway in three days—prep work was meticulous and the finish is flawless. Fair price and a tidy worker. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had him out to repaint the exterior woodwork. Really pleased with how it all looks. Steve is professional, reliable, and doesn't cut corners. Will definitely have him back for the kitchen next year.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: We were nervous about the wallpapering, but Steve made it easy. Explained everything clearly, matched the patterns perfectly, and left the place spotless. Honest and hardworking. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Lisa M.
